parameters.jsCode:
// Generate images with 3 fallback providers:
// 1. Pollinations.ai with secret key (no rate limit, ~10-20s)
// 2. Pexels stock photos (real photos from keyword search)
// 3. FFmpeg gradient (always works)
// Global time budget: 780s (leaves 120s buffer within 900s task timeout)
const { exec, execSync } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const scriptData = $input.first().json;
const prompts = scriptData.imagePrompts || [];
if (prompts.length === 0) throw new Error('No image prompts found');

const tmpDir = '/tmp/n8n_images_' + Date.now();
fs.mkdirSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true });

try {
  // API keys hardcoded directly (same approach as Gemini API key in URL)
  const config = {
    prompts,
    pollinationsKey: 'YOUR_POLLINATIONS_SECRET_KEY',
    pexelsKey: 'YOUR_PEXELS_API_KEY'
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'config.json'), JSON.stringify(config));

  const script = [
    "const https = require('https');",
    "const http = require('http');",
    "const { execSync } = require('child_process');",
    "const fs = require('fs');",
    "const path = require('path');",
    "const tmpDir = process.argv[2];",
    "const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'config.json'), 'utf8'));",
    "const prompts = config.prompts;",
    "const POLL_KEY = config.pollinationsKey || '';",
    "const PEXELS_KEY = config.pexelsKey || '';",
    "const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));",
    "const START_TIME = Date.now();",
    "const TIME_BUDGET_MS = 780000;",
    "function timeLeft() { return TIME_BUDGET_MS - (Date.now() - START_TIME); }",
    "",
    "function httpReq(url, opts) {",
    "  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {",
    "    const u = new URL(url);",
    "    const mod = u.protocol === 'http:' ? http : https;",
    "    const method = (opts&&opts.method)||'GET';",
    "    const headers = (opts&&opts.headers)||{};",
    "    const body = opts&&opts.body;",
    "    const maxR = (opts&&opts.maxR!==undefined)?opts.maxR:10;",
    "    const tout = (opts&&opts.timeout)||60000;",
    "    const r = mod.request({hostname:u.hostname,port:u.port,path:u.pathname+u.search,method,headers:{'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0',...headers}}, res => {",
    "      if (res.statusCode>=300 && res.statusCode<400 && res.headers.location) {",
    "        if (maxR<=0){reject(new Error('Too many redirects'));return;}",
    "        const loc = res.headers.location.startsWith('http')?res.headers.location:u.protocol+'//'+u.hostname+res.headers.location;",
    "        httpReq(loc,{...opts,maxR:maxR-1}).then(resolve).catch(reject);return;",
    "      }",
    "      const chunks=[];",
    "      res.on('data',c=>chunks.push(c));",
    "      res.on('end',()=>resolve({status:res.statusCode,headers:res.headers,body:Buffer.concat(chunks)}));",
    "    });",
    "    r.on('error',reject);",
    "    r.setTimeout(tout,()=>{r.destroy();reject(new Error('Timeout'));});",
    "    if(body)r.write(body);",
    "    r.end();",
    "  });",
    "}",
    "",
    "// Provider 1: Pollinations.ai (new unified endpoint gen.pollinations.ai)",
    "async function tryPollinations(prompt, idx) {",
    "  if (!POLL_KEY) throw new Error('No POLLINATIONS_SECRET_KEY');",
    "  const seed = Date.now() + idx * 1000;",
    "  const url = 'https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/' + encodeURIComponent(prompt) + '?model=flux&width=768&height=1344&nologo=true&seed=' + seed;",
    "  const headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + POLL_KEY };",
    "  const res = await httpReq(url, { timeout: 45000, headers });",
    "  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error('Poll HTTP ' + res.status);",
    "  const ct = (res.headers['content-type'] || '').toLowerCase();",
    "  if (!ct.includes('image') || res.body.length < 5000) throw new Error('Poll: not image (ct=' + ct + ',sz=' + res.body.length + ')');",
    "  return res.body;",
    "}",
    "",
    "// Provider 2: Pexels stock photos",
    "async function tryPexels(prompt) {",
    "  if (!PEXELS_KEY) throw new Error('No PEXELS_API_KEY');",
    "  const keywords = prompt",
    "    .replace(/vertical|9:16|image|vibrant|tech-themed|photorealistic|no text overlay|cinematic|dramatic|detailed|high quality|ultra|8k|4k|hd|portrait|landscape/gi, '')",
    "    .replace(/[,.:;!?()\\[\\]{}]/g, ' ')",
    "    .split(/\\s+/)",
    "    .filter(w => w.length > 2)",
    "    .slice(0, 4)",
    "    .join(' ')",
    "    .trim() || 'technology';",
    "  const url = 'https://api.pexels.com/v1/search?query=' + encodeURIComponent(keywords) + '&orientation=portrait&per_page=3&size=large';",
    "  const res = await httpReq(url, {",
    "    timeout: 15000,",
    "    headers: { 'Authorization': PEXELS_KEY }",
    "  });",
    "  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error('Pexels HTTP ' + res.status);",
    "  const json = JSON.parse(res.body.toString());",
    "  if (!json.photos || json.photos.length === 0) throw new Error('Pexels: no photos found');",
    "  const photo = json.photos[Math.floor(Math.random() * json.photos.length)];",
    "  const imgUrl = photo.src.large2x || photo.src.large || photo.src.original;",
    "  const imgRes = await httpReq(imgUrl, { timeout: 15000 });",
    "  if (imgRes.status !== 200 || imgRes.body.length < 5000) throw new Error('Pexels: bad download');",
    "  return imgRes.body;",
    "}",
    "",
    "// Provider 3: FFmpeg gradient (always works, local)",
    "function generateGradient(idx) {",
    "  const colors = ['0x1a1a2e','0x16213e','0x0f3460','0x533483','0x2b2d42','0x264653','0x2a9d8f','0xe76f51'];",
    "  const c = colors[idx % colors.length];",
    "  const out = path.join(tmpDir, 'grad_' + idx + '.png');",
    "  execSync('ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i color=c=' + c + ':s=768x1344:d=1 -frames:v 1 ' + out, { timeout: 10000 });",
    "  return fs.readFileSync(out);",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function genImage(prompt, idx, remaining) {",
    "  const tl = timeLeft();",
    "  const perImageBudget = tl / remaining;",
    "",
    "  if (perImageBudget < 20000) {",
    "    process.stderr.write('  #' + (idx+1) + ' budget critical (' + Math.round(tl/1000) + 's left) -> gradient\\n');",
    "    return { base64: generateGradient(idx).toString('base64'), provider: 'gradient' };",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  if (perImageBudget < 40000) {",
    "    process.stderr.write('  #' + (idx+1) + ' budget low (' + Math.round(tl/1000) + 's left) -> Pexels/gradient\\n');",
    "    try {",
    "      const img = await tryPexels(prompt);",
    "      process.stderr.write('  #' + (idx+1) + ' OK via Pexels (' + img.length + ' bytes)\\n');",
    "      return { base64: img.toString('base64'), provider: 'Pexels' };",
    "    } catch(e) {",
    "      process.stderr.write('    Pexels: ' + e.message.substring(0,80) + '\\n');",
    "      return { base64: generateGradient(idx).toString('base64'), provider: 'gradient' };",
    "    }",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  // Try Pollinations (2 attempts)",
    "  for (let a = 0; a < 2; a++) {",
    "    if (timeLeft() < 50000) break;",
    "    try {",
    "      if (a > 0) { process.stderr.write('    Pollinations retry...\\n'); await sleep(5000); }",
    "      const img = await tryPollinations(prompt, idx);",
    "      process.stderr.write('  #' + (idx+1) + ' OK via Pollinations (' + img.length + ' bytes)\\n');",
    "      return { base64: img.toString('base64'), provider: 'Pollinations' };",
    "    } catch(e) {",
    "      process.stderr.write('    Pollinations[' + a + ']: ' + e.message.substring(0,120) + '\\n');",
    "    }",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  // Try Pexels stock photos",
    "  try {",
    "    const img = await tryPexels(prompt);",
    "    process.stderr.write('  #' + (idx+1) + ' OK via Pexels (' + img.length + ' bytes)\\n');",
    "    return { base64: img.toString('base64'), provider: 'Pexels' };",
    "  } catch(e) {",
    "    process.stderr.write('    Pexels: ' + e.message.substring(0,80) + '\\n');",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  // Last resort: gradient",
    "  process.stderr.write('  #' + (idx+1) + ' using gradient fallback\\n');",
    "  return { base64: generateGradient(idx).toString('base64'), provider: 'gradient' };",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function main() {",
    "  const res = [];",
    "  const providerLog = [];",
    "  process.stderr.write('Keys: Pollinations=' + (POLL_KEY ? 'yes(' + POLL_KEY.substring(0,6) + '...)' : 'NO') + ' Pexels=' + (PEXELS_KEY ? 'yes(' + PEXELS_KEY.substring(0,6) + '...)' : 'NO') + '\\n');",
    "  process.stderr.write('Endpoint: gen.pollinations.ai/image/ (unified API)\\n');",
    "  for (let i = 0; i < prompts.length; i++) {",
    "    if (i > 0) { await sleep(3000); }",
    "    const remaining = prompts.length - i;",
    "    process.stderr.write('Image ' + (i+1) + '/' + prompts.length + ' (' + Math.round(timeLeft()/1000) + 's left)\\n');",
    "    const result = await genImage(prompts[i], i, remaining);",
    "    providerLog.push(result.provider);",
    "    res.push(result.base64);",
    "  }",
    "  const summary = providerLog.join(', ');",
    "  process.stderr.write('Done. Providers: ' + summary + '\\n');",
    "  // Output both images and provider info",
    "  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ images: res, providers: providerLog }));",
    "}",
    "main().catch(e => { process.stderr.write('FATAL: ' + e.message.substring(0,500) + '\\n'); process.exit(1); });"
  ];

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'generate.js'), script.join('\n'));

  const output = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    exec(
      `node "${path.join(tmpDir, 'generate.js')}" "${tmpDir}"`,
      { timeout: 840000, maxBuffer: 100 * 1024 * 1024 },
      (error, stdout, stderr) => {
        if (error) {
          const fm = (stderr||'').match(/FATAL: ([\s\S]+)/);
          const tail = (stderr||'').split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim()).slice(-5).join(' | ');
          reject(new Error(fm ? fm[1].trim() : tail || error.message));
        } else {
          resolve(stdout);
        }
      }
    );
  });

  const result = JSON.parse(output);
  const imageBase64Array = result.images;
  const providers = result.providers;

  return {
    json: {
      imageBase64Array,
      imageCount: imageBase64Array.length,
      providers,
      providerSummary: providers.join(', '),
      script: scriptData.script,
      title: scriptData.title,
      description: scriptData.description,
      tags: scriptData.tags
    }
  };
} finally {
  try { fs.rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) {}
}
